entries.topic: Deviant Connor after Markus dies at the bomb
originals: Markus shot dead in the hold with a deviant Connor: does Connor arm the bomb?
entries.answer: No: the line from Markus's death at the bomb goes straight to DEVIANT CONNOR IN CORRIDOR #3, bypassing ARM EXPLOSIVE; the Markus template's hold 'Lose the fight' variant has no arming
entries.source: flowchart Detroit-Crossroads-014.jpg (viewed) and note node C105 'C104, and C58 (Markus died at the bomb)'; wiki '(if Markus died trying to activate the bomb - leads to Deviant Connor in Corridor #3)'
entries.fix: ch30.mjs markusDies(): for where==='hold' drop `s.ch30ShipSunk=true;s.ch30JerichoBlown='connor'` (takeover 'c3' stays); C23-escape3 outcome texts must not describe the ship sinking on that path
